Q1.rationale: No segment grants a right to use residual knowledge, ideas or know-how retained in unaided memory; the NDA only restricts use and copying of Confidential Information and says nothing about residuals.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Segment 3 bars disclosure to any third party, which covers government agencies and regulators, and the only exception (segment 13) covers disclosures required by law or a competent authority, not voluntary reports of possible violations.
Q2.label: Entailment
